g.text: U4 gives DVI a defined reset after 3.3 V rises.

g.desc: U4 gives DVI a defined reset after 3.3 V rises.

g.text: ADDR low selects 0x23. U4 delay is 200 ms nominal.

g.desc: ADDR low selects 0x23. U4 delay is 200 ms nominal.

g.text: R20/R21 DNP: fit only if bottom-board pull-ups are absent.

g.desc: R20/R21 DNP: fit only if bottom-board pull-ups are absent.

g.text: Keep U3 optical aperture clear; do not solder center metal.

g.desc: Keep U3 optical aperture clear; do not solder center metal.

g.text: R10 holds BLANK_5V high; tubes stay off.

g.desc: R10 holds BLANK_5V high; tubes stay off.

g.text: ARM = 1: Q1 enables all four buffers.

g.desc: ARM = 1: Q1 enables all four buffers.

g.text: Keep BLANK high while arming and loading data.

g.desc: Keep BLANK high while arming and loading data.

g.text: No 5 V pull-up connects directly to an MCU pin.

g.desc: No 5 V pull-up connects directly to an MCU pin.

g.text: 1. ARM low; configure SER/SRCK/RCK low and BLANK high.

g.desc: 1. ARM low; configure SER/SRCK/RCK low and BLANK high.

g.text: 2. ARM high; clock 32 zero bits, pulse RCK with SRCK low.

g.desc: 2. ARM high; clock 32 zero bits, pulse RCK with SRCK low.

g.text: 3. Load the desired frame; only then enable BLANK PWM.

g.desc: 3. Load the desired frame; only then enable BLANK PWM.

g.text: 4. BLANK low = lit. A logic one in a drain bit lights a filament.

g.desc: 4. BLANK low = lit. A logic one in a drain bit lights a filament.

g.text: Start with 100 kHz SPI mode 0; verify signals before raising speed.

g.desc: Start with 100 kHz SPI mode 0; verify signals before raising speed.

g.text: Four non-inverting channels. BLANK high disables every drain output.

g.desc: Four non-inverting channels. BLANK high disables every drain output.
